name: password-strength
title: Password Strength
description: A gauge under a password field: four segments (2px ink frame) that fill with speed lines, one after the other in steps; the top level is an ink flat. The label sits beside the gauge on paper and is announced politely; the gauge is role=meter. Props: value (the password, scored locally by passwordScore: length, lower/upper case, digits, symbols; no dictionary, no network) or score 0-4 (overrides value), labels (five, default Too short, Weak, Fair, Good, Strong), minLength (default 8). Also exports passwordScore(password, minLength?).
docs: Import from "@/components/manga/password-strength". Give it the password, or your own score.

meta.tagline: A four-step gauge that fills with speed lines.
meta.usage:
import { PasswordStrength, passwordScore } from "@/components/manga/password-strength"

<Input type="password" value={pw} onChange={(e) => setPw(e.target.value)} />
<PasswordStrength value={pw} />
<PasswordStrength score={3} labels={["Empty", "Poor", "OK", "Good", "Great"]} />

props.name: value
props.description: The password to estimate locally. Ignored when score is given.

props.name: score
props.description: A score from your own estimate. Overrides value.

props.name: labels
props.description: Five labels for the scores 0 to 4.
